## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.



### What job boards and ATS's does Simplify's job application autofill support?



Simplify Copilot is able to autofill job applications on over 100 job boards and application portals including Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Taleo, Avature, Lever, and SmartRecruiters, just to name a few. Our extension also integrates with job boards like Linkedin and Indeed to analyze job descriptions and identify keywords missing in your resume. You'll know when a site is supported if the Simplify popup appears – we're constantly adding compatibility to new job boards!



### Is there a limit to how many applications I can autofill with Simplify Copilot?

There is no limit on how many applications you can submit with Copilot! Our autofill, application tracker, job matches, and basic resume builder are features we commit to keeping free for everyone.



### Does Simplify's autofill application extension work for both full-time jobs and internship applications?

Yes! The Simplify extension will autofill your application on any supported job platform – regardless of the nature or type of the job. We've helped users apply to jobs ranging from nurses to truck drivers to software engineers and even to CEO's!



### How does Simplify autofill my job applications?

Think of Simplify like Google's generic autofill but designed specifically to help you accurately fill out job applications. When you first sign up on Simplify, we'll ask you to set up a profile with the data we'll need to autofill your job applications. After that, the only thing you'll need is to add the Simplify Copilot extension to your web browser. Now, when you navigate to any compatible job posting, you'll see the Simplify Copilot popup and give you the option to autofill the application. Simplify analyzes the application questions and maps them to the data you provided on your profile. For questions specific to the job, you can use our AI to generate a personalized response based on your resume and work history!

The better way to job search. Quick apply and autofill job applications in one click. Track jobs, companies, resumes & more!

The Autofill Tool and Career Copilot for Job Applications – used by 1,000,000+ job seekers.

Simplify Copilot is an AI tool designed to help you job search more efficiently. Autofill job applications, generate tailored resumes and cover letters, and track every step of your job search–all in one place.

✦ Built by Job Seekers, for Job Seekers
Ever spent dozens of hours filling out the same application details over and over? We’ve been there too. That’s why we built Simplify Copilot: a smart, efficient way to job search that actually works and has helped applicants submit over 100 million applications and land thousands of job offers.

⭐ Our Features ⭐

✔️ Autofill Applications on All Major ATSs
Automate job applications across thousands of job boards and ATS platforms like Workday, Lever, Greenhouse, and more—no limits, free forever.

✔️ Identify Missing Keywords in Your Resume
We analyze the job description you're applying to and shows you the most important keywords missing from your resume.

✔️ AI-Powered Resumes & Cover Letters
Generate tailored, ATS-friendly resumes and personalized cover letters using our recruiter-approved AI. Our free resume builder has been used to create over 1,000,000 resumes.

✔️ Personalized Job Recommendations
Tell us your dealbreakers (minimum salary, location, etc.) and we'll match you with jobs that fit YOU. No more endlessly scrolling on job boards.

✔️ All-In-One Job Tracker
Bookmark jobs anywhere on the web and track your submitted applications, LinkedIn profiles, referrals, and interview notes from one simple dashboard.

- Save Hours on Applications: Cut application time from 10+ minutes to seconds

- Higher Interview Rate: Our AI resume builder helps get your resume past ATS filters

# Is Simplify Copilot Worth It? Full Review + Top Alternative

- Brian
- June 26, 2025





Simplify Copilot is one of several tools aiming to make job applications easier – mainly by autofilling forms and helping you optimize responses on the fly.

But how far does it really go? In this review, we’ll break down what Simplify Copilot offers, how it compares in 2026, and where it might fall short.

You might want to jump to our comparison with JobCopilot to understand why it’s becoming the go-to choice for job seekers who want more than just browser-based assistance.


## Table of Contents


## What is Simplify Copilot?

Simplify Copilot is a browser-based tool that helps users speed through online job applications by auto-filling common fields. It plugs into your browser and draws on the details you’ve already provided – think resumes, basic info, and preferences – to reduce the amount of typing involved. It’s a component of the larger Simplify.jobs ecosystem, but here we’re looking strictly at what the Copilot does.

Automate Your Job Applications with AI 🚀

Try the leading AI Agent for job seekers – autonomous, safe, fully personalized, and trusted by 100,000+ users to land interviews faster.

Check Out JobCopilot →


### Simplify Copilot Core Features

Works with 100+ Job Sites

→ From platforms like Greenhouse to Workday, Simplify Copilot supports a wide range of job portals. It recognizes form fields on supported sites and inserts your saved data automatically. It’s mostly aimed at streamlining repetitive parts of the application process – name, education, work history, and so on.

Generates Responses to Typical Questions

→ Some applications ask open-ended questions – “Tell us why you’re a fit,” for example. Copilot uses AI to suggest ready-made answers based on the job description and your resume. The suggestions aren’t perfect, but you can tweak them on the spot.

Highlights Keyword Gaps in Your Resume

→ One of the more analytical features lets you compare your resume against the job post. It flags keywords that seem important but are missing or underused , which could affect how your resume performs with ATS filters.

Quick Apply with One Click
